subject.title: improve(mattermost): restart only the changed account on config reload

question: Should OpenClaw expose `reload.accountScopedRestart` as a supported channel-plugin capability and accept Mattermost's account-isolation guarantee as the first opt-in implementation?
rationale: The patch is technically plausible and proven, but it establishes a durable plugin lifecycle contract whose safety depends on plugin-authored isolation claims and gateway recovery semantics; repository policy requires explicit owner direction for that API boundary.

options.title: Approve the opt-in contract
options.body: Accept the documented capability and Mattermost opt-in after the final head is refreshed, checks pass, and the gateway lifecycle owner confirms the isolation and recovery semantics.

options.title: Retain wholesale reload only
options.body: Decline the new plugin API and keep all channel configuration reloads on the existing whole-channel lifecycle path.

recommendation.title: Approve the opt-in contract
recommendation.body: Accept the documented capability and Mattermost opt-in after the final head is refreshed, checks pass, and the gateway lifecycle owner confirms the isolation and recovery semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal ties this person to the existing channel-reload lifecycle and suppression invariants that define the decision boundary.
